pro_course_detail.description:
1. What kind of course is it ? 
It's very structured classes using text book. 

2. What books do we use? 

1)	"Yonsei University Korean" or  ”Vitamin Korean“ Course
The most students like "Yonsei University Korean" or  ”Vitamin Korean“ series.
They have 6 books by levels and you can improve your Korean level very balanced 
and there are many exercise in it.
Each book takes about 15hours to finish and you can talk in Korean when you finish 1st book. 

2)	”Korean Grammar in Use“ or your favorite textbook 
One of the most popular Textbook.
We will make many sentences and I will correct them checking what we use frequently use in our life and what we don’t.
There are 3 books in series (beginner, intermediate, advanced) 
You will be able to make simple conversation after learning half of the beginner book, and will understand almost all of daily Korean grammar when you finish intermediate one.
 
3）《延世韩国语》《活学活用韩语语法》或者 你喜欢的教材 （for Chinese speakers）
《延世韩国语》是韩语学习界非常经典的一套教材，分六个等级，精准对应TOPIK考试的6个级别。学完1级就可以进行简单的交流，学完3级基本就可以应对大部分的日常会话。4级以上开始比较侧重高级的书面表达。
《活学活用韩语语法》是韩语语法界的宝典级语法书，简洁明了，足够的例子和练习，是不可多得的语法界绝绝子的存在。

4）「延世韓国語」あるいは お好きなテキスト （for Japanese speakers）
《延世韩国语》は、韓国語学習の定番テキストで、TOPIK試験の6つのレベルにぴったりと対応した6段階のレベルに分かれています。 レベル1以降は簡単なコミュニケーションができるようになり、レベル3以降はほとんどの日常会話に対応できるようになり、レベル4以降は高度な文章表現に焦点が当てられるようになります。


3. Home work?
I will give you Homework with exercises in the book, and other things if you want more.

4. How often do you recommend to have classes?
I highly recommend you to have 2 classes a week, you can buy 5 or 10 classes package, it's cheaper and will make you motivated 💪💪




In our first class, we are going to decide what book we use. I am sure, you will like your books

Thank you very much~ , See you in our class! ^^

Some basic facts about Chinese:
Chinese is a tonal language (4 tone, or  6 tones in Cantonese), with a well-defined set of characters and a simple grammar. For instance, there is no conjugation. Mastering 1000 characters is enough for handling daily situations, both in and out of a professional context.
A language like English uses the 26-letters Latin alphabet. Chinese has no alphabet. However, it uses a set of 214 keys (or radicals), which make it possible to find a word in a dictionary, and to write the characters.
The pronunciation of Chinese is helped by pinyin, which is a way to write Chinese using Latin characters. It is possible to start speaking Chinese immediately once you master pinyin.

We will study early writings which generally derived from philosophical or religious essays such as the works of Confucius (551-479 BC) , Lao-tzu (probably 4th century BC) and Sun Tzu's Art of War.
